purpose: Connect building-control evidence to property purchase due diligence.
guardrails: Missing building-control evidence is not itself proof of non-compliance.
Presence of a completion certificate is not a substitute for reviewing its scope and linked records.
Planning and building-control evidence must be reconciled separately.
Do not infer the legality of an extension solely from its physical existence.
Do not provide a final professional certification opinion from document matching alone.
official_data_route: National Building Control Office / BCMS open data and relevant Building Control Authority
